## Summary

I escalated ticket T-5005 to a human engineer. The ticket reported Grafana dashboards showing data gaps and missing alerts starting around 03:00. While investigation revealed that all monitoring pods (Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager, Node-Exporter) in the monitoring namespace appear healthy and running, the symptoms strongly suggest an issue with Prometheus's TSDB storage—likely either disk capacity exhaustion or storage corruption. Since this could risk data loss, it requires hands-on investigation of the persistent volume and pod filesystem that cannot be safely performed without direct access.
